observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same beige tufted 2-seater sofa from slightly different angles.
The sofa has a diamond-tufted backrest and armrests, with visible wear and stains on the seat cushion.
The fabric appears to be a light-colored velvet or microfiber material, showing discoloration and dirt, especially on the seat.
The sofa is placed on a tiled floor, with a metal staircase and some furniture in the background.
Watermark 'HOMEHUB SOLUTIONS' is overlaid on both photos.
No brand or model is visible on the sofa in either photo.
The seller claims it is available for immediate pickup and delivery.

claims.claim: Available for immediate pickup and delivery
claims.evidence: This is a logistical claim that cannot be verified from photos alone.

risks.risk: The sofa may have structural damage or loose joints not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A close-up video or photo showing the underside, legs, and connections of the sofa.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially unstable or damaged

risks.risk: The upholstery may be stained or damaged beyond visible wear, affecting durability and appearance.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the seat cushion showing the extent of stains and discoloration.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having hidden stains or damage

risks.risk: The sofa may not be in working condition (e.g., broken springs, loose cushions).
risks.proof: A video showing the sofa being gently pushed and shaken to test for stability and cushion movement.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the seat cushion showing stains and discoloration.
Close-up photo of the underside and legs of the sofa.
Video showing the sofa being gently pushed and shaken to test for stability and cushion movement.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
